name: browser-use
headline: go sdk for anthropic claude code cli
short_description: Claude Code Go SDK enables developers to integrate Anthropic's Claude Code CLI into Go applications. Operations teams benefit from automated code generation, review, and optimization. It connects to existing Go workflows and tools, enhancing productivity for software development and maintenance tasks.
author: lancekrogers

sections.overview:
Claude Code Go SDK is a comprehensive Go library that wraps the Claude Code CLI's non-interactive prompt surface (`claude -p`), allowing developers to build AI-powered coding assistants and automated workflows directly in Go applications. The SDK supports streaming responses, multi-turn session management with resume and fork capabilities, Model Context Protocol (MCP) integration for extending Claude with external tools, and advanced features like subagent orchestration, budget tracking, and fine-grained permission controls. Operations and development teams use it to automate code generation, review, and optimization while maintaining cost control and security through plugin systems for logging, metrics, audit, and tool filtering. The library includes nine interactive demos and comprehensive test coverage, making it production-ready for intelligent agents and multi-turn conversations.
Automated code generation and review workflows integrated into Go applications
Real-time streaming responses for interactive coding assistants
Multi-turn conversations with session persistence and forking for code exploration
Cost-controlled AI agent orchestration with budget tracking and spending limits
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/lancekrogers/claude-code-go`
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
